SELECT
  $1::text AS title,
  $2::text AS company,
  $3::text AS location,
  $4::text AS work_mode,
  $5::text AS url,

  check_result.should_skip,
  check_result.reason,
  check_result.job_id,
  check_result.status,
  check_result.last_seen_at,
  check_result.match_score

FROM public.should_skip_ai_analysis(
  NULLIF($5::text, ''),
  public.compute_job_fingerprint(
    $2::text,
    $1::text
  )
) AS check_result;

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.search_runs
SET
  finished_at = timezone('utc', now()),
  status = 'completed',
  results_found = $2::integer,
  new_jobs_found = $3::integer,
  jobs_analyzed = $4::integer,
  existing_jobs_seen = $5::integer,
  run_details = $6::jsonb
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING *;
